104	## 8. Functional Requirements
105	
106	Behaviours covered by deferred gaps (upload failure and duplicate names, the share dialog, list sorting and pagination, empty/loading/error states, revocation while a document is open, accessibility of per-row buttons, concurrent edits) are not specified here; see Deferred in section 3. Acceptance criteria marked (draft) rest on an item that is not Approved, Decided or Explicit.
107	
108	### Document ownership and access
109	
110	Purpose: signed-in employees manage their own documents, and only the owner and chosen colleagues can open them.
111	
112	#### Confirmed requirements
113	
114	- **FR-001** Upload, rename, delete and share are available to every signed-in employee on documents they own. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
115	- **FR-002** Upload, rename, delete and share are not offered on documents the employee does not own. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
116	- **FR-003** Only the owner and the named colleagues the owner has shared a document with, as viewer or editor, can open it; there are no public links. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-003] [Decision: DEC-004] [Decision: DEC-005]
117	- **FR-004** When the owner revokes a colleague's access, that colleague can no longer open the document. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-004] [Decision: DEC-005]
118	
119	#### Undecided behaviour and assumptions
120	
121	- **FR-005** Unknown: what an editor may do beyond the owner's actions (edit content only, or also rename, delete, re-share or change others' access) and whether a viewer may download or copy a document. If editors can re-share, documents can reach people the owner did not choose, which conflicts with DEC-004. Awaiting Q-001. FR-002 states that these actions are not offered on documents the employee does not own; how that applies to editors depends on the answer. [Inferred: FEA-003 · Unknown]
122	- **FR-006** Assumption: the access restriction in FR-003 applies to every way of opening a document, not only from the Documents list. How employees sign in is not established. [Assumption: ASM-F-001 · Assumption] [Customer: FEA-002]
123	- **FR-007** Unknown: what happens to an employee's documents and the shares on them when the employee leaves or the account is deactivated, and whether ownership can be transferred or documents recovered. Awaiting Q-007. [Inferred: FEA-010 · Unknown]
124	
125	#### Acceptance criteria
126	
127	- **AC-001** Given a signed-in employee who owns a document, When they use the Documents list, Then rename, delete and share can be started for that document and Upload is available (where the rename control appears is not yet decided). [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
128	- **AC-002** Given a signed-in employee who neither owns document D nor has been given access to it, When they use the Documents list or any route offering actions on D, Then rename, delete and share are not offered for D. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
129	- **AC-003** Given a signed-in employee who neither owns document D nor has been given access to it, When they try to open D, Then they cannot open it. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
130	- **AC-004** Given document D owned by O and shared with colleague C, When O revokes C's access and C then tries to open D, Then C cannot open D. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-005]
131	- **AC-005** (draft) Given a colleague C with viewer or editor access to document D, When C attempts to rename, delete, re-share, change others' access or download D, Then the outcome is Unknown until Q-001 is answered; no pass or fail condition is chosen here. [Inferred: FEA-003 · Unknown]
132	
133	### Sharing
134	
135	Purpose: owners give named colleagues access to a document and can take it away.
136	
137	#### Confirmed requirements
138	
139	- **FR-008** Owners share a document with named colleagues as viewer or editor, like Google Drive, and can revoke access at any time. The Google Drive reference is the customer's wording; which Google Drive behaviours apply beyond viewer, editor and revocation is not specified. [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-005]
140	
141	#### Undecided behaviour and assumptions
142	
143	- **FR-009** Unknown: who counts as a named colleague (assumed to be other signed-in employees of the organisation only) and how the owner finds and picks them. Awaiting Q-003. [Inferred: FEA-015 · Unknown] [Assumption: ASM-G-001 · Assumption]
144	- **FR-010** Unknown: whether a colleague is told when a document is shared with them, when their role changes or when access is revoked, and through which channel. Awaiting Q-009. [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown]
145	
146	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
147	
148	- **FR-011** Consider a record of sharing, revocation and deletion that lets owners see who was given access, whose access was revoked and when a document was deleted. No requirement asks for it and the customer stated that no compliance rules apply. Awaiting Q-009. [Inferred: FEA-013 · Recommended (awaiting approval)]
149	
150	#### Acceptance criteria
151	
152	- **AC-006** (draft) Given document D owned by O, When O shares D with a named colleague C as viewer, Then C can open D. [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-005]
153	- **AC-007** Given an owner using any sharing option, When they look for a way to share by public link, Then none is provided. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-005]
154	- **AC-008** (draft) Given an owner who names a person who is not a signed-in employee of the organisation (for example an external person), When they share, Then the outcome is Unknown until Q-003 is answered; no accept or reject behaviour is chosen here. [Inferred: FEA-015 · Unknown] [Assumption: ASM-G-001]
155	
156	### Documents list
157	
158	Purpose: the page where employees see and act on their documents.
159	
160	#### Undecided behaviour and assumptions
161	
162	- **FR-012** Unknown: where a colleague finds documents shared with them (in the Documents list, elsewhere, or nowhere) and which actions appear on a row the user does not own. Awaiting Q-004. [Inferred: FEA-004 · Unknown]
163	- **FR-013** Unknown: which changes update "Modified", whether it shows who made the change, and how older dates and time zones are shown. Awaiting Q-010. [Inferred: FEA-014 · Unknown]
164	
165	#### Acceptance criteria
166	
167	- **AC-009** (draft) Given colleague C who has been given access to document D, When C views the Documents list, Then where D appears and which actions are shown on it are Unknown until Q-004 is answered. [Inferred: FEA-004 · Unknown]
168	- **AC-014** (draft) Given a library of up to 1,000 documents, When a page loads (assumed to be the Documents list), Then it loads within two seconds. Behaviour above 1,000 documents, the measurement method and the test conditions are not specified (Q-008). [Decision: REQ-005 · Unknown] [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Assumption: ASM-G-002]
169	
170	### Upload, rename and delete
171	
172	Purpose: the document actions other than sharing, each limited to two clicks.
173	
174	#### Confirmed requirements
175	
176	- **FR-014** Each of upload, rename, delete and share takes at most two clicks. [Customer: REQ-001 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-001]
177	
178	#### Undecided behaviour and assumptions
179	
180	- **FR-015** Unknown: what counts as a click (choosing a file, typing a name, picking a role, confirming a deletion) and where counting starts. A delete confirmation or a share with a named colleague and a role may not fit within two clicks. Awaiting Q-005. [Inferred: FEA-009 · Unknown]
181	- **FR-016** Unknown: whether deletion is permanent or recoverable (for example undo or restore, and for how long), and what happens to colleagues' viewer or editor access when a shared document is deleted. Awaiting Q-002. [Inferred: FEA-006 · Unknown]
182	- **FR-017** Unknown: how rename is reached, which characters and lengths are allowed, how file extensions are handled, what happens when the new name matches an existing document, and what error is shown when validation fails. Awaiting Q-006. [Inferred: FEA-007 · Unknown]
183	
184	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
185	
186	- **FR-018** If Delete cannot be undone, ask the user to confirm and name the document that will be deleted. This applies only if deletion is irreversible (FR-016). The supporting guidance is low confidence: its source describes itself as a test fixture, not real documentation. [Research: FEA-005 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-001-01 · Research-supported]
187	
188	#### Acceptance criteria
189	
190	- **AC-010** (draft) Given a signed-in owner on the Documents list, When they upload, rename, delete or share a document, Then each action completes within two clicks, counted as defined once Q-005 is answered. [Customer: REQ-001 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-001] [Inferred: FEA-009]
191	- **AC-011** (draft) Given Delete is irreversible (not yet decided) and an owner chooses Delete on document D, When the confirmation appears, Then it names D and D is removed only after the owner confirms. [Research: FEA-005 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-001-01]
192	- **AC-012** (draft) Given an owner has deleted a document D that is shared with colleague C, When C then tries to open D, Then the result for D and for C's access is Unknown until Q-002 is answered. [Inferred: FEA-006 · Unknown]
193	- **AC-013** (draft) Given an owner renaming a document, When the new name is invalid or matches an existing document, Then the outcome and the error shown are Unknown until Q-006 is answered. [Inferred: FEA-007 · Unknown]
194	
195	## 9. State Transitions and Edge Cases
196	
197	### Document lifecycle
198	
199	| State | Event | Next state | Who can trigger | Provenance |
200	|---|---|---|---|---|
201	| No document | Employee uploads a file | Owned document, not shared | Any signed-in employee | [Customer: REQ-001 · Unknown] |
202	| Owned document | Owner renames | Owned document with new name (rules Unknown) | Owner | [Customer: REQ-001 · Unknown] |
203	| Owned document, not shared | Owner shares with a named colleague as viewer or editor | Shared document | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
204	| Owned or shared document | Owner deletes | Unknown (permanently removed, or recoverable; effect on colleagues' access Unknown) | Owner | [Inferred: FEA-006 · Unknown] |
205	| Owned or shared document | Owner's account is deactivated or the owner leaves | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-010 · Unknown] |
206	| Shared document | Editor attempts an action beyond opening and viewing | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-003 · Unknown] |
207	
208	### Access grant lifecycle (one colleague on one document)
209	
210	| State | Event | Next state | Who can trigger | Provenance |
211	|---|---|---|---|---|
212	| No access | Owner shares as viewer | Viewer | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
213	| No access | Owner shares as editor | Editor | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
214	| Viewer or editor | Owner revokes access | No access | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
215	| Viewer | Role change to editor | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown] |
216	| Editor | Role change to viewer | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown] |
217	| Viewer or editor | Colleague is notified of the change | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown] |
218	
219	Edge cases: destructive action (delete) and its recovery are Unknown (FR-016); invalid rename input is Unknown (FR-017); unauthorised opening is covered by AC-003 and AC-004. Empty, loading, error, upload failure, duplicate-name and concurrency behaviour have no decision and are listed under Deferred in section 3. Duplicate shares and repeated submissions are not covered by any input (see section 1).
220	
221	## 10. Non-Functional Requirements
222	
223	- **NFR-001** The system must be fast; DEC-003 defines this as the two-second page-load target in NFR-002. [Customer: REQ-002 · Approved: DEC-003] [Decision: DEC-003]

# Document Management and Sharing: Feature Specification

## 1. Document Status

- Run ID: 20261013-091918-e32cff
- Date: 2026-10-13
- Run mode: fixture
- Publication status: pending final pass
- Known limitations:
  - Capture: status complete, but only one screen with a single table row was captured. Empty, loading, error and confirmation states are unobserved, and no dialogs or screens for Upload, Share or Delete were captured (the buttons have no visible target). Rename has no captured control.
  - Research: run in fixture mode (live search disabled; the source metadata records "fixture mode: robots.txt not checked (no network)", see sources/SRC-c52222b5.metadata.json, field `warnings`). One finding was kept (F-GAP-001-01, low confidence, from a source that describes itself as a test fixture). One finding was dropped. Research on rename produced no findings. Research was allowed for only two gaps (DEC-007).
  - Decisions: the answers recorded in DEC-001 to DEC-007 come from an evaluation case file (source `eval_case_file`), not from a live customer conversation. DEC-001 and DEC-002 carry the same verbatim answer, as do DEC-005 and DEC-006.
  - Customer questions Q-001 to Q-010 have no recorded answer.
  - No input or decision covers duplicate shares (sharing the same document with the same colleague twice) or repeated share submissions, and no question has been put on them. They are unspecified here. Repeated upload submissions belong to deferred GAP-006 and are not specified either.
- Open stale items: none
- Unresolved blocking issues: open blocking questions Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-004 and Q-007; items REQ-001, REQ-004 and REQ-005 still carry the issue `unknown`.

## 2. Executive Summary

The customer wants employees to manage their documents easily, with fast pages, secure documents and sharing that works like other tools. Through the recorded answers this has been narrowed to a Documents list where every signed-in employee can upload, rename, delete and share their own documents, each in at most two clicks. Owners share a document with named colleagues as viewer or editor and can revoke access at any time. Only the owner and the people the owner shares with can open a document, there are no public links, and no extra encryption or compliance rules apply. Pages must load within two seconds for a library of up to 1,000 documents.

Much behaviour is still undecided. The most important open decisions are what editors and viewers may do, whether a deleted document can be restored and what happens to colleagues' access when it is deleted, who can be shared with, where colleagues find documents shared with them, and what happens to a leaver's documents. Sections 8 and 16 list these, and ten customer questions (Q-001 to Q-010) are waiting for answers. Seven gaps were deferred and are listed under Deferred in section 3.

## 3. Goals and Scope

### Goals

- Let every signed-in employee upload, rename, delete and share their own documents, each in at most two clicks (REQ-001, label Unknown; DEC-001). See FR-001 and FR-014.
- Restrict opening a document to its owner and the named colleagues the owner has shared it with (REQ-003, label Approved: DEC-004). See FR-003 and NFR-003.
- Meet the two-second page-load target for up to 1,000 documents (REQ-002, label Approved: DEC-003; REQ-005, label Unknown). See NFR-001 and NFR-002.

### In Scope

- Documents list with Upload, rename, delete and share for documents the employee owns (REQ-001, label Unknown).
- Sharing with named colleagues as viewer or editor, and revocation (REQ-004, label Unknown).
- Access restriction on opening documents (REQ-003, label Approved: DEC-004).
- Approved gaps to be resolved before build, all with label Approved: DEC-007: GAP-001 (delete confirmation, recoverability and effect on shares), GAP-002 (what viewer and editor permit), GAP-003 (whether shared documents appear in the list), GAP-004 (rename), GAP-007 (how the two-click limit is counted), GAP-011 (ownership when an employee leaves), GAP-013 (notifications), GAP-015 (meaning and format of Modified).

### Out of Scope / Rejected

- Public links for sharing: the customer's answer in DEC-005 says "no public links". This is a customer exclusion recorded in the answer; no separate rejection action was recorded.
- No other item has been rejected. Exclusions are not inferred from absence in the mockup.

### Deferred

Each item below was deferred by DEC-007. None is specified in this document.

- GAP-005 · Deferred: DEC-007. Share flow not captured: choosing colleagues, roles and revoking.
- GAP-006 · Deferred: DEC-007. Upload behaviour: types, sizes, failures and duplicate names.
- GAP-008 · Deferred: DEC-007. Listing up to 1,000 documents: sort, filter, search and pagination.
- GAP-009 · Deferred: DEC-007. Empty, loading, success and error states unobserved. Noted as an implementation detail to follow established design-system guidance; no decision or research backs this.
- GAP-010 · Deferred: DEC-007. Effect of revoking access while a colleague has the document open.
- GAP-012 · Deferred: DEC-007. Icon-only Delete button and per-row action accessibility. Noted as an implementation detail (labelling and keyboard/screen-reader identification); no decision or research backs this.
- GAP-014 · Deferred: DEC-007. Concurrent actions by owner and editors.

## 4. Users and Roles

- Signed-in employee and document owner: may upload, rename, delete and share their own documents (REQ-001, label Unknown; FEA-001, label Explicit; DEC-001).
- Colleague with viewer access and colleague with editor access: given access by an owner (REQ-004, label Unknown; DEC-005). What each may do is undecided (FEA-003, label Unknown; Q-001).
- Administrator or any other role: none is mentioned in any decision. Whether one is needed is open (FEA-010, label Unknown; Q-007).
- How employees sign in is not established by any supplied document.

## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage

Capture status is complete: one page ("Documents"), fixture mode, with screenshot, text, accessibility tree and HTML.

- Screen SCR-001 (Observed): "Documents", with an Upload button and a table (Name, Modified, unlabelled actions column).
- Components SCR-002 (Upload button, Observed) and SCR-003 (Documents table, Observed) with per-row Share and Delete buttons. Default state shows one row: "Q3 plan.docx", modified "2 days ago".
- Flows SCR-004, SCR-005 and SCR-006 (all Observed): the Upload, Share and Delete buttons have no captured target.
- Data entity SCR-007 (Observed): Document, with visible fields Name and Modified.
- Ambiguous behaviours: who can upload; accepted file types and sizes; upload failure; same-name uploads; who can share and delete; permission levels; delete confirmation, permanence and undo; effect on shares of deleting; the icon-only Delete button; meaning of Modified; sorting, filtering and pagination; empty list.
- Not observed: rename control, empty, loading, error and confirmation states, any dialog.

## 6. Requirements Traceability

| REQ | Requirement | Treatment | Label | References |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| REQ-001 | Users should be able to manage their documents easily. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-001, FR-002, FR-014, FR-015, FR-016, FR-017, FR-018, AC-001, AC-002, AC-010 to AC-013; Q-002, Q-005, Q-006; DEC-001 |
| REQ-002 | The system must be fast. | addressed | Approved: DEC-003 | NFR-001, NFR-002; DEC-003 |
| REQ-003 | Documents should be secure. | addressed | Approved: DEC-004 | FR-003, FR-004, NFR-003, NFR-004, AC-003, AC-004; DEC-004 |
| REQ-004 | Sharing should work like in other tools. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-004, FR-005, FR-008, FR-009, FR-010, AC-004 to AC-008; Q-001, Q-003, Q-009; DEC-005 |
| REQ-005 | Pages load within two seconds for a library of up to 1,000 documents (created by DEC-003). | partially addressed | Unknown | NFR-002, AC-014; Q-008; DEC-003 |

## 7. Gaps Identified

| GAP | Gap | Approval | Path | Priority | Status | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GAP-001 | Delete confirmation, recoverability and effect on shares | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | both | critical | open (researched; customer decision pending, Q-002) | One low-confidence finding kept; trash, retention and effect on collaborators unanswered. |
| GAP-002 | What viewer and editor access each permit | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending, Q-001) | Over-exposure or deletion by non-owners cannot be ruled out until decided. |
| GAP-003 | Whether the Documents list includes documents shared with the user | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | important | open (customer decision pending, Q-004) | Colleagues need a way to reach shared documents without owner-only actions. |
| GAP-004 | Rename not supported by any captured screen or action | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | both | important | open (researched, no findings; customer decision pending, Q-006) | Confirmed action with no control or validation rules. |
| GAP-005 | Share flow not captured: choosing colleagues, roles and revoking | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | both | important | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
| GAP-006 | Upload behaviour: types, sizes, failures and duplicate names | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | both | important | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
| GAP-007 | How the two-click limit is counted | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | important | open (customer decision pending, Q-005) | The limit may conflict with safeguards such as a delete confirmation. |
| GAP-008 | Listing up to 1,000 documents: sort, filter, search and pagination | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | both | important | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
| GAP-009 | Empty, loading, success and error states unobserved | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | research | important | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
| GAP-010 | Effect of revoking access while a colleague has the document open | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | both | important | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
| GAP-011 | Ownership when an employee leaves or loses access | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | important | open (customer decision pending, Q-007) | No administrator role or retention rule is stated. |
| GAP-012 | Icon-only Delete button and per-row action accessibility | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | research | optional | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
| GAP-013 | Whether colleagues are notified of sharing or revocation | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending, Q-009) | No notification channel is identified. |
| GAP-014 | Concurrent actions by owner and editors | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | both | optional | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
| GAP-015 | Meaning and format of "Modified" | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending, Q-010) | Owners may rely on Modified to notice editors' changes. |

## 8. Functional Requirements

Behaviours covered by deferred gaps (upload failure and duplicate names, the share dialog, list sorting and pagination, empty/loading/error states, revocation while a document is open, accessibility of per-row buttons, concurrent edits) are not specified here; see Deferred in section 3. Acceptance criteria marked (draft) rest on an item that is not Approved, Decided or Explicit. Acceptance criteria that state "placeholder" have no expected outcome yet and are not testable until the named question is answered.

### Document ownership and access

Purpose: signed-in employees manage their own documents, and only the owner and chosen colleagues can open them.

#### Confirmed requirements

- **FR-001** Upload, rename, delete and share are available to every signed-in employee on documents they own. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **FR-002** Upload, rename, delete and share are not offered on documents the employee does not own. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **FR-003** Only the owner and the named colleagues the owner has shared a document with, as viewer or editor, can open it; there are no public links. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-003] [Decision: DEC-004] [Decision: DEC-005]
- **FR-004** When the owner revokes a colleague's access, that colleague can no longer open the document. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-004] [Decision: DEC-005]

#### Undecided behaviour and assumptions

If editors can re-share, documents can reach people the owner did not choose, which conflicts with DEC-004. Awaiting Q-001. ## 9. State Transitions and Edge Cases

### Document lifecycle

States: No document; Owned document, not shared; Shared document (an owned document with at least one colleague holding access).

| State | Event | Next state | Who can trigger | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| No document | Employee uploads a file | Owned document, not shared | Any signed-in employee | [Customer: REQ-001 · Unknown] |
| Owned document, not shared or Shared document | Owner renames | Same state, with the new name (rules Unknown) | Owner | [Customer: REQ-001 · Unknown] |
| Owned document, not shared | Owner shares with a named colleague as viewer or editor | Shared document | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
| Shared document | Owner revokes the last colleague's access | Owned document, not shared | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-005] |
| Owned document, not shared or Shared document | Owner deletes | Unknown (permanently removed, or recoverable; effect on colleagues' access Unknown) | Owner | [Inferred: FEA-006 · Unknown] |
| Owned document, not shared or Shared document | Owner's account is deactivated or the owner leaves | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-010 · Unknown] |
| Shared document | Editor attempts an action beyond opening and viewing | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-003 · Unknown] |

### Access grant lifecycle (one colleague on one document)

| State | Event | Next state | Who can trigger | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| No access | Owner shares as viewer | Viewer | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
| No access | Owner shares as editor | Editor | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
| Viewer or editor | Owner revokes access | No access | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
| Viewer | Role change to editor | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown] |
| Editor | Role change to viewer | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown] |

Edge cases: destructive action (delete) and its recovery are Unknown (FR-016); invalid rename input is Unknown (FR-017); unauthorised opening is covered by AC-003 and AC-004. Whether and how a colleague is notified when access is granted, changed or revoked is not a state change and is Unknown (FR-010, Q-009). Empty, loading, error, upload failure, duplicate-name and concurrency behaviour have no decision and are listed under Deferred in section 3, and repeated upload submissions belong to deferred GAP-006. Duplicate shares and repeated share submissions are not covered by any input (see section 1).

Research was limited to two gaps (DEC-007), in fixture mode.

- GAP-001 questions about Google Drive and comparable tools (trash, retention, effect on collaborators) and about WCAG 3.3.4 remain unanswered by research (section 16, research questions 1 and 2).

1	# Document Management and Sharing: Feature Specification
2	
3	## 1. Document Status
4	
5	- Run ID: 20261013-091918-e32cff
6	- Date: 2026-10-13
7	- Run mode: fixture
8	- Publication status: pending final pass
9	- Known limitations:
10	  - Capture: status complete, but only one screen with a single table row was captured. Empty, loading, error and confirmation states are unobserved, and no dialogs or screens for Upload, Share or Delete were captured (the buttons have no visible target). Rename has no captured control.
11	  - Research: run in fixture mode (live search disabled; the source metadata records "fixture mode: robots.txt not checked (no network)", see sources/SRC-c52222b5.metadata.json, field `warnings`). One finding was kept (F-GAP-001-01, low confidence, from a source that describes itself as a test fixture). One finding was dropped. Research on rename produced no findings. Research was allowed for only two gaps (DEC-007).
12	  - Decisions: the answers recorded in DEC-001 to DEC-007 come from an evaluation case file (source `eval_case_file`), not from a live customer conversation. DEC-001 and DEC-002 carry the same verbatim answer, as do DEC-005 and DEC-006.
13	  - Customer questions Q-001 to Q-010 have no recorded answer.
14	  - No input or decision covers duplicate shares (sharing the same document with the same colleague twice) or repeated share submissions, and no question has been put on them. They are unspecified here. Repeated upload submissions belong to deferred GAP-006 and are not specified either.
15	- Open stale items: none
16	- Unresolved blocking issues: open blocking questions Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-004 and Q-007; items REQ-001, REQ-004 and REQ-005 still carry the issue `unknown`.
17	
18	## 2. Executive Summary
19	
20	The customer wants employees to manage their documents easily, with fast pages, secure documents and sharing that works like other tools. Through the recorded answers this has been narrowed to a Documents list where every signed-in employee can upload, rename, delete and share their own documents, each in at most two clicks. Owners share a document with named colleagues as viewer or editor and can revoke access at any time. Only the owner and the people the owner shares with can open a document, there are no public links, and no extra encryption or compliance rules apply. Pages must load within two seconds for a library of up to 1,000 documents.
21	
22	Much behaviour is still undecided. The most important open decisions are what editors and viewers may do, whether a deleted document can be restored and what happens to colleagues' access when it is deleted, who can be shared with, where colleagues find documents shared with them, and what happens to a leaver's documents. Sections 8 and 16 list these, and ten customer questions (Q-001 to Q-010) are waiting for answers. Seven gaps were deferred and are listed under Deferred in section 3.
23	
24	## 3. Goals and Scope
25	
26	### Goals
27	
28	- Let every signed-in employee upload, rename, delete and share their own documents, each in at most two clicks (REQ-001, label Unknown; DEC-001). See FR-001 and FR-014.
29	- Restrict opening a document to its owner and the named colleagues the owner has shared it with (REQ-003, label Approved: DEC-004). See FR-003 and NFR-003.
30	- Meet the two-second page-load target for up to 1,000 documents (REQ-002, label Approved: DEC-003; REQ-005, label Unknown). See NFR-001 and NFR-002.
31	
32	### In Scope
33	
34	- Documents list with Upload, rename, delete and share for documents the employee owns (REQ-001, label Unknown).
35	- Sharing with named colleagues as viewer or editor, and revocation (REQ-004, label Unknown).
36	- Access restriction on opening documents (REQ-003, label Approved: DEC-004).
37	- Approved gaps to be resolved before build, all with label Approved: DEC-007: GAP-001 (delete confirmation, recoverability and effect on shares), GAP-002 (what viewer and editor permit), GAP-003 (whether shared documents appear in the list), GAP-004 (rename), GAP-007 (how the two-click limit is counted), GAP-011 (ownership when an employee leaves), GAP-013 (notifications), GAP-015 (meaning and format of Modified).
38	
39	### Out of Scope / Rejected
40	
41	- Public links for sharing: the customer's answer in DEC-005 says "no public links". This is a customer exclusion recorded in the answer; no separate rejection action was recorded.
42	- No other item has been rejected. Exclusions are not inferred from absence in the mockup.
43	
44	### Deferred
45	
46	Each item below was deferred by DEC-007. None is specified in this document.
47	
48	- GAP-005 · Deferred: DEC-007. Share flow not captured: choosing colleagues, roles and revoking.
49	- GAP-006 · Deferred: DEC-007. Upload behaviour: types, sizes, failures and duplicate names.
50	- GAP-008 · Deferred: DEC-007. Listing up to 1,000 documents: sort, filter, search and pagination.
51	- GAP-009 · Deferred: DEC-007. Empty, loading, success and error states unobserved. Noted as an implementation detail to follow established design-system guidance; no decision or research backs this.
52	- GAP-010 · Deferred: DEC-007. Effect of revoking access while a colleague has the document open.
53	- GAP-012 · Deferred: DEC-007. Icon-only Delete button and per-row action accessibility. Noted as an implementation detail (labelling and keyboard/screen-reader identification); no decision or research backs this.
54	- GAP-014 · Deferred: DEC-007. Concurrent actions by owner and editors.
55	
56	## 4. Users and Roles
57	
58	- Signed-in employee and document owner: may upload, rename, delete and share their own documents (REQ-001, label Unknown; FEA-001, label Explicit; DEC-001).
59	- Colleague with viewer access and colleague with editor access: given access by an owner (REQ-004, label Unknown; DEC-005). What each may do is undecided (FEA-003, label Unknown; Q-001).
60	- Administrator or any other role: none is mentioned in any decision. Whether one is needed is open (FEA-010, label Unknown; Q-007).
61	- How employees sign in is not established by any supplied document.
62	
63	## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage
64	
65	Capture status is complete: one page ("Documents"), fixture mode, with screenshot, text, accessibility tree and HTML.
66	
67	- Screen SCR-001 (Observed): "Documents", with an Upload button and a table (Name, Modified, unlabelled actions column).
68	- Components SCR-002 (Upload button, Observed) and SCR-003 (Documents table, Observed) with per-row Share and Delete buttons. Default state shows one row: "Q3 plan.docx", modified "2 days ago".
69	- Flows SCR-004, SCR-005 and SCR-006 (all Observed): the Upload, Share and Delete buttons have no captured target.
70	- Data entity SCR-007 (Observed): Document, with visible fields Name and Modified.
71	- Ambiguous behaviours: who can upload; accepted file types and sizes; upload failure; same-name uploads; who can share and delete; permission levels; delete confirmation, permanence and undo; effect on shares of deleting; the icon-only Delete button; meaning of Modified; sorting, filtering and pagination; empty list.
72	- Not observed: rename control, empty, loading, error and confirmation states, any dialog.
73	
74	## 6. Requirements Traceability
75	
76	| REQ | Requirement | Treatment | Label | References |
77	|---|---|---|---|---|
78	| REQ-001 | Users should be able to manage their documents easily. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-001, FR-002, FR-014, FR-015, FR-016, FR-017, FR-018, AC-001, AC-002, AC-010 to AC-013; Q-002, Q-005, Q-006; DEC-001 |
79	| REQ-002 | The system must be fast. | addressed | Approved: DEC-003 | NFR-001, NFR-002; DEC-003 |
80	| REQ-003 | Documents should be secure. | addressed | Approved: DEC-004 | FR-003, FR-004, NFR-003, NFR-004, AC-003, AC-004; DEC-004 |
81	| REQ-004 | Sharing should work like in other tools. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-004, FR-005, FR-008, FR-009, FR-010, AC-004 to AC-008; Q-001, Q-003, Q-009; DEC-005 |
82	| REQ-005 | Pages load within two seconds for a library of up to 1,000 documents (created by DEC-003). | partially addressed | Unknown | NFR-002, AC-014; Q-008; DEC-003 |
83	
84	## 7. Gaps Identified
85	
86	| GAP | Gap | Approval | Path | Priority | Status | Rationale |
87	|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
88	| GAP-001 | Delete confirmation, recoverability and effect on shares | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | both | critical | open (researched; customer decision pending, Q-002) | One low-confidence finding kept; trash, retention and effect on collaborators unanswered. |
89	| GAP-002 | What viewer and editor access each permit | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending, Q-001) | Over-exposure or deletion by non-owners cannot be ruled out until decided. |
90	| GAP-003 | Whether the Documents list includes documents shared with the user | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | important | open (customer decision pending, Q-004) | Colleagues need a way to reach shared documents without owner-only actions. |
91	| GAP-004 | Rename not supported by any captured screen or action | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | both | important | open (researched, no findings; customer decision pending, Q-006) | Confirmed action with no control or validation rules. |
92	| GAP-005 | Share flow not captured: choosing colleagues, roles and revoking | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | both | important | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
93	| GAP-006 | Upload behaviour: types, sizes, failures and duplicate names | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | both | important | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
94	| GAP-007 | How the two-click limit is counted | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | important | open (customer decision pending, Q-005) | The limit may conflict with safeguards such as a delete confirmation. |
95	| GAP-008 | Listing up to 1,000 documents: sort, filter, search and pagination | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | both | important | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
96	| GAP-009 | Empty, loading, success and error states unobserved | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | research | important | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
97	| GAP-010 | Effect of revoking access while a colleague has the document open | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | both | important | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
98	| GAP-011 | Ownership when an employee leaves or loses access | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | important | open (customer decision pending, Q-007) | No administrator role or retention rule is stated. |
99	| GAP-012 | Icon-only Delete button and per-row action accessibility | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | research | optional | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
100	| GAP-013 | Whether colleagues are notified of sharing or revocation | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending, Q-009) | No notification channel is identified. |
101	| GAP-014 | Concurrent actions by owner and editors | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | both | optional | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
102	| GAP-015 | Meaning and format of "Modified" | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending, Q-010) | Owners may rely on Modified to notice editors' changes. |
103	
104	## 8. Functional Requirements
105	
106	Behaviours covered by deferred gaps (upload failure and duplicate names, the share dialog, list sorting and pagination, empty/loading/error states, revocation while a document is open, accessibility of per-row buttons, concurrent edits) are not specified here; see Deferred in section 3. Acceptance criteria marked (draft) rest on an item that is not Approved, Decided or Explicit. Acceptance criteria that state "placeholder" have no expected outcome yet and are not testable until the named question is answered.
107	
108	### Document ownership and access
109	
110	Purpose: signed-in employees manage their own documents, and only the owner and chosen colleagues can open them.
111	
112	#### Confirmed requirements
113	
114	- **FR-001** Upload, rename, delete and share are available to every signed-in employee on documents they own. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
115	- **FR-002** Upload, rename, delete and share are not offered on documents the employee does not own. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
116	- **FR-003** Only the owner and the named colleagues the owner has shared a document with, as viewer or editor, can open it; there are no public links. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-003] [Decision: DEC-004] [Decision: DEC-005]
117	- **FR-004** When the owner revokes a colleague's access, that colleague can no longer open the document. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-004] [Decision: DEC-005]
118	
119	#### Undecided behaviour and assumptions
120	
121	- **FR-005** Unknown: what an editor may do beyond the owner's actions (edit content only, or also rename, delete, re-share or change others' access) and whether a viewer may download or copy a document. If editors can re-share, documents can reach people the owner did not choose, which conflicts with DEC-004. Awaiting Q-001. FR-002 states that these actions are not offered on documents the employee does not own; how that applies to editors depends on the answer. [Inferred: FEA-003 · Unknown]
122	- **FR-006** Assumption: the access restriction in FR-003 applies to every way of opening a document, not only from the Documents list. How employees sign in is not established. [Assumption: ASM-F-001 · Assumption] [Customer: FEA-002]
123	- **FR-007** Unknown: what happens to an employee's documents and the shares on them when the employee leaves or the account is deactivated, and whether ownership can be transferred or documents recovered. Awaiting Q-007. [Inferred: FEA-010 · Unknown]
124	
125	#### Acceptance criteria
126	
127	- **AC-001** Given a signed-in employee who owns a document, When they use the Documents list, Then rename, delete and share can be started for that document and Upload is available (where the rename control appears is not yet decided). [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
128	- **AC-002** Given a signed-in employee who neither owns document D nor has been given access to it, When they use the Documents list or any route offering actions on D, Then rename, delete and share are not offered for D. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
129	- **AC-003** Given a signed-in employee who neither owns document D nor has been given access to it, When they try to open D, Then they cannot open it. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
130	- **AC-004** Given document D owned by O and shared with colleague C, When O revokes C's access and C then tries to open D, Then C cannot open D. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-005]
131	- **AC-005** (draft) Placeholder, not testable until Q-001 is answered: Given a colleague C with viewer or editor access to document D, When C attempts to rename, delete, re-share, change others' access or download D, Then the expected outcome is to be defined from the answer; no pass or fail condition is chosen here. [Inferred: FEA-003 · Unknown]
132	
133	### Sharing
134	
135	Purpose: owners give named colleagues access to a document and can take it away.
136	
137	#### Customer answers on requirements that still carry an open issue
138	
139	REQ-004 still carries the issue `unknown` (label Unknown) pending Q-001 and Q-003, so the line below records the customer's answer in DEC-005 and is not confirmed.
140	
141	- **FR-008** Owners share a document with named colleagues as viewer or editor, like Google Drive, and can revoke access at any time. The Google Drive reference is the customer's wording; which Google Drive behaviours apply beyond viewer, editor and revocation is not specified. [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-005]
142	
143	#### Undecided behaviour and assumptions
144	
145	- **FR-009** Unknown: who counts as a named colleague (assumed to be other signed-in employees of the organisation only) and how the owner finds and picks them. Awaiting Q-003. [Inferred: FEA-015 · Unknown] [Assumption: ASM-G-001 · Assumption]
146	- **FR-010** Unknown: whether a colleague is told when a document is shared with them, when their role changes or when access is revoked, and through which channel. Awaiting Q-009. [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown]
147	
148	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
149	
150	- **FR-011** Consider a record of sharing, revocation and deletion that lets owners see who was given access, whose access was revoked and when a document was deleted. No requirement asks for it and the customer stated that no compliance rules apply. Awaiting Q-009. [Inferred: FEA-013 · Recommended (awaiting approval)]
151	
152	#### Acceptance criteria
153	
154	- **AC-006** (draft) Given document D owned by O, When O shares D with a named colleague C as viewer, Then C can open D. [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-005]
155	- **AC-007** Given an owner using any sharing option, When they look for a way to share by public link, Then none is provided. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-005]
156	- **AC-008** (draft) Placeholder, not testable until Q-003 is answered: Given an owner who names a person who is not a signed-in employee of the organisation (for example an external person), When they share, Then the expected accept or reject behaviour is to be defined from the answer; none is chosen here. [Inferred: FEA-015 · Unknown] [Assumption: ASM-G-001]
157	
158	### Documents list
159	
160	Purpose: the page where employees see and act on their documents.
161	
162	#### Undecided behaviour and assumptions
163	
164	- **FR-012** Unknown: where a colleague finds documents shared with them (in the Documents list, elsewhere, or nowhere) and which actions appear on a row the user does not own. Awaiting Q-004. [Inferred: FEA-004 · Unknown]
165	- **FR-013** Unknown: which changes update "Modified", whether it shows who made the change, and how older dates and time zones are shown. Awaiting Q-010. [Inferred: FEA-014 · Unknown]
166	
167	#### Acceptance criteria
168	
169	- **AC-009** (draft) Placeholder, not testable until Q-004 is answered: Given colleague C who has been given access to document D, When C views the Documents list, Then where D appears and which actions are shown on it are to be defined from the answer. [Inferred: FEA-004 · Unknown]
170	- **AC-014** (draft) Given a library of up to 1,000 documents, When a page loads (assumed to be the Documents list), Then it loads within two seconds. Behaviour above 1,000 documents, the measurement method and the test conditions are not specified (Q-008). [Decision: REQ-005 · Unknown] [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Assumption: ASM-G-002]
171	
172	### Upload, rename and delete
173	
174	Purpose: the document actions other than sharing, each limited to two clicks.
175	
176	#### Customer answers on requirements that still carry an open issue
177	
178	REQ-001 still carries the issue `unknown` (label Unknown), and what counts as a click is undecided (FEA-009, Q-005), so the line below records the customer's answer in DEC-001 and is not confirmed.
179	
180	- **FR-014** Each of upload, rename, delete and share takes at most two clicks; the click-counting rule is pending Q-005 (see FR-015). [Customer: REQ-001 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-001]
181	
182	#### Undecided behaviour and assumptions
183	
184	- **FR-015** Unknown: what counts as a click (choosing a file, typing a name, picking a role, confirming a deletion) and where counting starts. A delete confirmation or a share with a named colleague and a role may not fit within two clicks. Awaiting Q-005. [Inferred: FEA-009 · Unknown]
185	- **FR-016** Unknown: whether deletion is permanent or recoverable (for example undo or restore, and for how long), and what happens to colleagues' viewer or editor access when a shared document is deleted. Awaiting Q-002. [Inferred: FEA-006 · Unknown]
186	- **FR-017** Unknown: how rename is reached, which characters and lengths are allowed, how file extensions are handled, what happens when the new name matches an existing document, and what error is shown when validation fails. Awaiting Q-006. [Inferred: FEA-007 · Unknown]
187	
188	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
189	
190	- **FR-018** If Delete cannot be undone, ask the user to confirm and name the document that will be deleted. This applies only if deletion is irreversible (FR-016). The supporting guidance is low confidence: its source describes itself as a test fixture, not real documentation. [Research: FEA-005 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-001-01 · Research-supported]
191	
192	#### Acceptance criteria
193	
194	- **AC-010** (draft) Given a signed-in owner on the Documents list, When they upload, rename, delete or share a document, Then each action completes within two clicks, counted as defined once Q-005 is answered. [Customer: REQ-001 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-001] [Inferred: FEA-009]
195	- **AC-011** (draft) Given Delete is irreversible (not yet decided) and an owner chooses Delete on document D, When the confirmation appears, Then it names D and D is removed only after the owner confirms. [Research: FEA-005 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-001-01]
196	- **AC-012** (draft) Placeholder, not testable until Q-002 is answered: Given an owner has deleted a document D that is shared with colleague C, When C then tries to open D, Then the result for D and for C's access is to be defined from the answer. [Inferred: FEA-006 · Unknown]
197	- **AC-013** (draft) Placeholder, not testable until Q-006 is answered: Given an owner renaming a document, When the new name is invalid or matches an existing document, Then the outcome and the error shown are to be defined from the answer. [Inferred: FEA-007 · Unknown]
198	
199	## 9. State Transitions and Edge Cases
200	
201	### Document lifecycle
202	
203	States: No document; Owned document, not shared; Shared document (an owned document with at least one colleague holding access).
204	
205	| State | Event | Next state | Who can trigger | Provenance |
206	|---|---|---|---|---|
207	| No document | Employee uploads a file | Owned document, not shared | Any signed-in employee | [Customer: REQ-001 · Unknown] |
208	| Owned document, not shared or Shared document | Owner renames | Same state, with the new name (rules Unknown) | Owner | [Customer: REQ-001 · Unknown] |
209	| Owned document, not shared | Owner shares with a named colleague as viewer or editor | Shared document | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
210	| Shared document | Owner revokes the last colleague's access | Owned document, not shared | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-005] |
211	| Owned document, not shared or Shared document | Owner deletes | Unknown (permanently removed, or recoverable; effect on colleagues' access Unknown) | Owner | [Inferred: FEA-006 · Unknown] |
212	| Owned document, not shared or Shared document | Owner's account is deactivated or the owner leaves | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-010 · Unknown] |
213	| Shared document | Editor attempts an action beyond opening and viewing | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-003 · Unknown] |
214	
215	### Access grant lifecycle (one colleague on one document)
216	
217	| State | Event | Next state | Who can trigger | Provenance |
218	|---|---|---|---|---|
219	| No access | Owner shares as viewer | Viewer | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
220	| No access | Owner shares as editor | Editor | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
221	| Viewer or editor | Owner revokes access | No access | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
222	| Viewer | Role change to editor | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown] |
223	| Editor | Role change to viewer | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown] |
224	
225	Edge cases: destructive action (delete) and its recovery are Unknown (FR-016); invalid rename input is Unknown (FR-017); unauthorised opening is covered by AC-003 and AC-004. Whether and how a colleague is notified when access is granted, changed or revoked is not a state change and is Unknown (FR-010, Q-009). Empty, loading, error, upload failure, duplicate-name and concurrency behaviour have no decision and are listed under Deferred in section 3, and repeated upload submissions belong to deferred GAP-006. Duplicate shares and repeated share submissions are not covered by any input (see section 1).
226	
227	## 10. Non-Functional Requirements
228	
229	- **NFR-001** The system must be fast; DEC-003 defines this as the two-second page-load target in NFR-002. [Customer: REQ-002 · Approved: DEC-003] [Decision: DEC-003]
230	- **NFR-002** Pages load within two seconds for a library of up to 1,000 documents. Which pages are covered is only assumed (the Documents list); the measurement method, network and device conditions, and whether 1,000 includes shared documents are not stated (Q-008). [Decision: REQ-005 · Unknown] [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Assumption: ASM-G-002]
231	- **NFR-003** Documents are secure in the sense that only people the owner shares a document with can open it. [Customer: REQ-003 · Approved: DEC-004] [Decision: DEC-004]
232	- **NFR-004** No extra encryption or compliance obligations apply, per the customer; security scope is limited to the access restriction in FR-003. Whether organisation-wide policies apply regardless of this feature is not established. [Customer: FEA-012 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
233	
234	## 11. Data Model and Business Rules
235	
236	No schema, storage design or API was inspected, and none is claimed. Entity: Document. Visible fields (Observed): Name and Modified. Owner, size, type and access level are not shown in the capture and are not assumed. Relationships known from decisions: a document has one owner and zero or more named colleagues with the role viewer or editor.
237	
238	- **BR-001** Upload, rename, delete and share apply only to documents the user owns. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
239	- **BR-002** A document can be opened only by its owner and by colleagues the owner has shared it with. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
240	- **BR-003** A share grants one of two roles: viewer or editor. [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-005]
241	- **BR-004** The mockup shows a Document with the visible fields Name and Modified. [Mockup: SCR-007 · Observed]
242	
243	## 12. Screens and User Flows
244

7	      "notes": "The claim restates sources/SRC-c52222b5.txt line 3 almost word for word ('Ask for confirmation before an action that cannot be undone, and state the consequence in the dialog text, for example which item will be affected.'). It is attributed ('The guidance says') rather than presented as established practice, uses no stronger modality than the source, and adds no conditions. It bears on GAP-001 research question 2 (UX guidance on confirming destructive actions) and on the gap's open question of whether Delete asks for confirmation. No other finding in this run contradicts it. Confidence is already 'low' in the finding.",
8	      "limitations": [
9	        "Line 5 of the source says it 'is a test fixture for the Feature Research Agent and is not real documentation'. The metadata labels it source_type 'official_documentation', but the text does not support that label, so it cannot be cited as established UX guidance or as a WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.4 statement.",
10	        "Applies only to actions that cannot be undone. Whether Delete is permanent or recoverable is still open in GAP-001.",
11	        "General guidance on irreversible actions. It says nothing about trash, retention windows or what happens to collaborators' access when a shared document is deleted (GAP-001 research question 1 is still unanswered).",
12	        "Publication date 2025-03-01 comes from the fixture page itself and has not been checked independently."
13	      ]

18	      "finding_id": "F-GAP-001-02",
19	      "reasons": [
20	        {
21	          "code": "recommendation_not_reasonable",
22	          "explanation": "The claim matches source line 4 ('Do not ask for confirmation for actions that can be reversed with an undo control; offer undo instead.'), but the recommendation concludes that 'Either choice can fit the two-click limit in DEC-001 only if the confirmation or undo is not counted as an extra click'. The source says nothing about click counts. The capture shows Delete as a per-row trash-icon button (GAP-001, inventory SCR-003), so trash-icon plus confirm could already be two clicks, and an offered undo adds no click to the delete itself. How clicks are counted is still undecided (GAP-007), so the 'only if' condition does not follow from the evidence."

27	        }

6	     "question": "When you share a document, what can a viewer and an editor each do? For example, can an editor rename it, delete it, or share it with other people, and can a viewer download or copy it?",
7	     "why_it_matters": "You said only people the owner shares with can open a document, and that only owners manage their own documents. If editors can re-share, documents can reach people the owner never chose. If editors can delete or rename, they act on documents that are not theirs.",
8	     "affected_ids": ["GAP-002", "FEA-003", "REQ-001", "REQ-004", "REQ-003"],
9	     "topic_keywords": ["editor", "viewer", "permissions", "reshare"],
10	     "options": [
11	       {"option": "Editors change content only; viewers can only read. Only the owner renames, deletes and shares.", "trade_offs": "Strictest and matches 'owners manage their own documents'. Editors cannot fix names or share with a teammate, so owners do more of the work."},
12	       {"option": "Editors change content and can rename; only the owner deletes and shares.", "trade_offs": "More convenient for teams. Renaming changes what the owner sees in their own list, and the owner stays in control of who has access and of deletion."},
13	       {"option": "Editors can also share with others, like some other tools.", "trade_offs": "Most flexible, but access can spread beyond the people the owner chose, which conflicts with your security definition unless the owner approves each share."},
14	       {"option": "Viewers may also download or copy the document.", "trade_offs": "Easier for viewers, but a downloaded copy is outside the access control, so revoking access no longer protects that copy. This can be combined with any option above."}
15	     ],
16	     "recommendation": null, "blocking": true, "priority": "critical"},
17	    {"id": "Q-002",
18	     "question": "When someone deletes a document, is it gone for good, or can it be restored (and for how long)? And what happens to colleagues who were given access to it?",
19	     "why_it_matters": "A shared document may be one that colleagues are viewing or editing. One misclick could remove work other people rely on, and the choice decides whether delete needs a confirmation step, an undo or a trash area.",

The confirmation may count towards your two-click limit (see the two-click question). The only supporting guidance found is low-confidence and generic, and does not cover shared documents."},
24	       {"option": "Delete moves the document to a trash that the owner can restore from for a set period", "trade_offs": "Protects against mistakes and avoids a confirmation prompt, but needs a trash view, a retention period and rules for what colleagues see while the document is in the trash."},

# Stage 16: Report

Goal: an honest summary, the publication status written into the specification, and the
run closed. §7 Stage 16, §9.14.

## Steps

1. `run_state.py verify`, `run_state.py stage 16 --run <run-id> --start`.
2. `run_state.py report --run <run-id>`: merges agent warnings into `warnings.json`, computes the
   publication status (`validated`, `validated_with_warnings`, `not_fully_validated`, `blocked`;
   always `eval_only` in fixture mode) and writes `run_summary.json`.
3. Agent tool, `subagent_type: doc-writer`, `Mode: final`, same run details plus
   `Run summary: <run dir>/run_summary.json`. It rewrites only Document Status.
4. `<python> <skill_dir>/scripts/check_spec.py --run <run-id> --final` (Document Status shows the
   computed status exactly; nothing else changed). If it fails, one more `final` pass, then
   re-check.
5. `run_state.py record-revision --run <run-id> --final`, then
   `run_state.py stage 16 --run <run-id> --complete`, then `run_state.py end --run <run-id>`
   (removes `.active_run`; the session is released).

## Report to the user (in chat)

From `run_summary.json` and the artifacts:

- run ID and the spec path (`<run dir>/spec.md`); publication status and its reasons; run mode;
- counts: requirements by label, gaps by approval, findings by verification, questions answered
  vs open, stale items;
- capture and research limitations; budget usage (searches, fetches per gap);
- hook blocks, tamper reports, decision-provenance rejections;
- unresolved review issues; outstanding decisions (open questions), with your recorded
  interpretation of each decision;
- in fixture mode, that the status is `eval_only` and what the checks would have given.

The publication status describes workflow validation, not a guarantee that the product is
correct or compliant: say so.

1	# Document Management and Sharing: Feature Specification
2	
3	## 1. Document Status
4	
5	- Run ID: 20261013-091918-e32cff
6	- Date: 2026-10-13
7	- Run mode: fixture
8	- Publication status: pending final pass
9	- Known limitations:
10	  - Capture: status complete, but only one screen with a single table row was captured. Empty, loading, error and confirmation states are unobserved, and no dialogs or screens for Upload, Share or Delete were captured (the buttons have no visible target). Rename has no captured control.
11	  - Research: run in fixture mode (live search disabled; the source metadata records "fixture mode: robots.txt not checked (no network)", see sources/SRC-c52222b5.metadata.json, field `warnings`). One finding was kept (F-GAP-001-01, low confidence, from a source that describes itself as a test fixture). One finding was dropped. Research on rename produced no findings. Research was allowed for only two gaps (DEC-007).
12	  - Decisions: the answers recorded in DEC-001 to DEC-007 come from an evaluation case file (source `eval_case_file`), not from a live customer conversation. DEC-001 and DEC-002 carry the same verbatim answer, as do DEC-005 and DEC-006.
13	  - Customer questions Q-001 to Q-010 have no recorded answer.
14	  - No input or decision covers duplicate shares (sharing the same document with the same colleague twice) or repeated share submissions, and no question has been put on them. They are unspecified here. Repeated upload submissions belong to deferred GAP-006 and are not specified either.
15	- Open stale items: none
16	- Unresolved blocking issues: open blocking questions Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-004 and Q-007; items REQ-001, REQ-004 and REQ-005 still carry the issue `unknown`.
17	
18	## 2. Executive Summary
19	
20	The customer wants employees to manage their documents easily, with fast pages, secure documents and sharing that works like other tools. Through the recorded answers this has been narrowed to a Documents list where every signed-in employee can upload, rename, delete and share their own documents, each in at most two clicks. Owners share a document with named colleagues as viewer or editor and can revoke access at any time. Only the owner and the people the owner shares with can open a document, there are no public links, and no extra encryption or compliance rules apply. Pages must load within two seconds for a library of up to 1,000 documents.
21	
22	Much behaviour is still undecided. The most important open decisions are what editors and viewers may do, whether a deleted document can be restored and what happens to colleagues' access when it is deleted, who can be shared with, where colleagues find documents shared with them, and what happens to a leaver's documents. Sections 8 and 16 list these, and ten customer questions (Q-001 to Q-010) are waiting for answers. Seven gaps were deferred and are listed under Deferred in section 3.
23	
24	## 3. Goals and Scope
25	
26	### Goals
27	
28	- Let every signed-in employee upload, rename, delete and share their own documents, each in at most two clicks (REQ-001, label Unknown; DEC-001). See FR-001 and FR-014.
29	- Restrict opening a document to its owner and the named colleagues the owner has shared it with (REQ-003, label Approved: DEC-004). See FR-003 and NFR-003.
30	- Meet the two-second page-load target for up to 1,000 documents (REQ-002, label Approved: DEC-003; REQ-005, label Unknown). See NFR-001 and NFR-002.
31	
32	### In Scope
33	
34	- Documents list with Upload, rename, delete and share for documents the employee owns (REQ-001, label Unknown).
35	- Sharing with named colleagues as viewer or editor, and revocation (REQ-004, label Unknown).
36	- Access restriction on opening documents (REQ-003, label Approved: DEC-004).
37	- Approved gaps to be resolved before build, all with label Approved: DEC-007: GAP-001 (delete confirmation, recoverability and effect on shares), GAP-002 (what viewer and editor permit), GAP-003 (whether shared documents appear in the list), GAP-004 (rename), GAP-007 (how the two-click limit is counted), GAP-011 (ownership when an employee leaves), GAP-013 (notifications), GAP-015 (meaning and format of Modified).
38	
39	### Out of Scope / Rejected
40	
41	- Public links for sharing: the customer's answer in DEC-005 says "no public links". This is a customer exclusion recorded in the answer; no separate rejection action was recorded.
42	- No other item has been rejected. Exclusions are not inferred from absence in the mockup.
43	
44	### Deferred
45	
46	Each item below was deferred by DEC-007. None is specified in this document.
47	
48	- GAP-005 · Deferred: DEC-007. Share flow not captured: choosing colleagues, roles and revoking.
49	- GAP-006 · Deferred: DEC-007. Upload behaviour: types, sizes, failures and duplicate names.
50	- GAP-008 · Deferred: DEC-007. Listing up to 1,000 documents: sort, filter, search and pagination.
51	- GAP-009 · Deferred: DEC-007. Empty, loading, success and error states unobserved. Noted as an implementation detail to follow established design-system guidance; no decision or research backs this.
52	- GAP-010 · Deferred: DEC-007. Effect of revoking access while a colleague has the document open.
53	- GAP-012 · Deferred: DEC-007. Icon-only Delete button and per-row action accessibility. Noted as an implementation detail (labelling and keyboard/screen-reader identification); no decision or research backs this.
54	- GAP-014 · Deferred: DEC-007. Concurrent actions by owner and editors.
55	
56	## 4. Users and Roles
57	
58	- Signed-in employee and document owner: may upload, rename, delete and share their own documents (REQ-001, label Unknown; FEA-001, label Explicit; DEC-001).
59	- Colleague with viewer access and colleague with editor access: given access by an owner (REQ-004, label Unknown; DEC-005). What each may do is undecided (FEA-003, label Unknown; Q-001).
60	- Administrator or any other role: none is mentioned in any decision. Whether one is needed is open (FEA-010, label Unknown; Q-007).
61	- How employees sign in is not established by any supplied document.
62	
63	## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage
64	
65	Capture status is complete: one page ("Documents"), fixture mode, with screenshot, text, accessibility tree and HTML.
66	
67	- Screen SCR-001 (Observed): "Documents", with an Upload button and a table (Name, Modified, unlabelled actions column).
68	- Components SCR-002 (Upload button, Observed) and SCR-003 (Documents table, Observed) with per-row Share and Delete buttons. Default state shows one row: "Q3 plan.docx", modified "2 days ago".
69	- Flows SCR-004, SCR-005 and SCR-006 (all Observed): the Upload, Share and Delete buttons have no captured target.
70	- Data entity SCR-007 (Observed): Document, with visible fields Name and Modified.
71	- Ambiguous behaviours: who can upload; accepted file types and sizes; upload failure; same-name uploads; who can share and delete; permission levels; delete confirmation, permanence and undo; effect on shares of deleting; the icon-only Delete button; meaning of Modified; sorting, filtering and pagination; empty list.
72	- Not observed: rename control, empty, loading, error and confirmation states, any dialog.
73	
74	## 6. Requirements Traceability
75	
76	| REQ | Requirement | Treatment | Label | References |
77	|---|---|---|---|---|
78	| REQ-001 | Users should be able to manage their documents easily. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-001, FR-002, FR-014, FR-015, FR-016, FR-017, FR-018, AC-001, AC-002, AC-010 to AC-013; Q-002, Q-005, Q-006; DEC-001 |
79	| REQ-002 | The system must be fast. | addressed | Approved: DEC-003 | NFR-001, NFR-002; DEC-003 |
80	| REQ-003 | Documents should be secure. | addressed | Approved: DEC-004 | FR-003, FR-004, NFR-003, NFR-004, AC-003, AC-004; DEC-004 |
81	| REQ-004 | Sharing should work like in other tools. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-004, FR-005, FR-008, FR-009, FR-010, AC-004 to AC-008; Q-001, Q-003, Q-009; DEC-005 |
82	| REQ-005 | Pages load within two seconds for a library of up to 1,000 documents (created by DEC-003). | partially addressed | Unknown | NFR-002, AC-014; Q-008; DEC-003 |
83	
84	## 7. Gaps Identified
85	
86	| GAP | Gap | Approval | Path | Priority | Status | Rationale |
87	|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
88	| GAP-001 | Delete confirmation, recoverability and effect on shares | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | both | critical | open (researched; customer decision pending, Q-002) | One low-confidence finding kept; trash, retention and effect on collaborators unanswered. |
89	| GAP-002 | What viewer and editor access each permit | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending, Q-001) | Over-exposure or deletion by non-owners cannot be ruled out until decided. |
90	| GAP-003 | Whether the Documents list includes documents shared with the user | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | important | open (customer decision pending, Q-004) | Colleagues need a way to reach shared documents without owner-only actions. |

# Document Management and Sharing: Feature Specification

## 1. Document Status

- Run ID: 20261013-091918-e32cff
- Date: 2026-10-13
- Run mode: fixture
- Publication status: eval_only
- Status reasons (from run_summary.json): fixture mode is always eval_only (checks would give validated_with_warnings); review warnings on item 16.
- Known limitations:
  - Capture: status complete, but only one screen with a single table row was captured. Empty, loading, error and confirmation states are unobserved, and no dialogs or screens for Upload, Share or Delete were captured (the buttons have no visible target). Rename has no captured control.
  - Research: run in fixture mode (live search disabled; the source metadata records "fixture mode: robots.txt not checked (no network)", see sources/SRC-c52222b5.metadata.json, field `warnings`). One finding was kept (F-GAP-001-01, low confidence, from a source that describes itself as a test fixture). One finding was dropped. Research on rename produced no findings. Research was allowed for only two gaps (DEC-007).
  - Decisions: the answers recorded in DEC-001 to DEC-007 come from an evaluation case file (source `eval_case_file`), not from a live customer conversation. DEC-001 and DEC-002 carry the same verbatim answer, as do DEC-005 and DEC-006.
  - Customer questions Q-001 to Q-010 have no recorded answer (outstanding decisions: Q-001 to Q-010).
  - Review: passed in round 2 with one unresolved issue (item 16): AC-005, AC-008, AC-009, AC-010, AC-012, AC-013 and AC-014 become testable only after customer answers to Q-001 to Q-006 and Q-008.
  - No input or decision covers duplicate shares (sharing the same document with the same colleague twice) or repeated share submissions, and no question has been put on them. They are unspecified here. Repeated upload submissions belong to deferred GAP-006 and are not specified either.
- Open stale items: none
- Unresolved blocking issues: open blocking questions Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-004 and Q-007; items REQ-001, REQ-004 and REQ-005 still carry the issue `unknown`.

## 2. Executive Summary

The customer wants employees to manage their documents easily, with fast pages, secure documents and sharing that works like other tools. Through the recorded answers this has been narrowed to a Documents list where every signed-in employee can upload, rename, delete and share their own documents, each in at most two clicks. Owners share a document with named colleagues as viewer or editor and can revoke access at any time. Only the owner and the people the owner shares with can open a document, there are no public links, and no extra encryption or compliance rules apply. Pages must load within two seconds for a library of up to 1,000 documents.

Much behaviour is still undecided. The most important open decisions are what editors and viewers may do, whether a deleted document can be restored and what happens to colleagues' access when it is deleted, who can be shared with, where colleagues find documents shared with them, and what happens to a leaver's documents. Sections 8 and 16 list these, and ten customer questions (Q-001 to Q-010) are waiting for answers. Seven gaps were deferred and are listed under Deferred in section 3.

## 3. Goals and Scope

### Goals

- Let every signed-in employee upload, rename, delete and share their own documents, each in at most two clicks (REQ-001, label Unknown; DEC-001). See FR-001 and FR-014.
- Restrict opening a document to its owner and the named colleagues the owner has shared it with (REQ-003, label Approved: DEC-004). See FR-003 and NFR-003.
- Meet the two-second page-load target for up to 1,000 documents (REQ-002, label Approved: DEC-003; REQ-005, label Unknown). See NFR-001 and NFR-002.

### In Scope

- Documents list with Upload, rename, delete and share for documents the employee owns (REQ-001, label Unknown).
- Sharing with named colleagues as viewer or editor, and revocation (REQ-004, label Unknown).
- Access restriction on opening documents (REQ-003, label Approved: DEC-004).
- Approved gaps to be resolved before build, all with label Approved: DEC-007: GAP-001 (delete confirmation, recoverability and effect on shares), GAP-002 (what viewer and editor permit), GAP-003 (whether shared documents appear in the list), GAP-004 (rename), GAP-007 (how the two-click limit is counted), GAP-011 (ownership when an employee leaves), GAP-013 (notifications), GAP-015 (meaning and format of Modified).

### Out of Scope / Rejected

- Public links for sharing: the customer's answer in DEC-005 says "no public links". This is a customer exclusion recorded in the answer; no separate rejection action was recorded.
- No other item has been rejected. Exclusions are not inferred from absence in the mockup.

### Deferred

Each item below was deferred by DEC-007. None is specified in this document.

- GAP-005 · Deferred: DEC-007. Share flow not captured: choosing colleagues, roles and revoking.
- GAP-006 · Deferred: DEC-007. Upload behaviour: types, sizes, failures and duplicate names.
- GAP-008 · Deferred: DEC-007. Listing up to 1,000 documents: sort, filter, search and pagination.
- GAP-009 · Deferred: DEC-007. Empty, loading, success and error states unobserved. Noted as an implementation detail to follow established design-system guidance; no decision or research backs this.
- GAP-010 · Deferred: DEC-007. Effect of revoking access while a colleague has the document open.
- GAP-012 · Deferred: DEC-007. Icon-only Delete button and per-row action accessibility. Noted as an implementation detail (labelling and keyboard/screen-reader identification); no decision or research backs this.
- GAP-014 · Deferred: DEC-007. Concurrent actions by owner and editors.

## 4. Users and Roles

- Signed-in employee and document owner: may upload, rename, delete and share their own documents (REQ-001, label Unknown; FEA-001, label Explicit; DEC-001).
- Colleague with viewer access and colleague with editor access: given access by an owner (REQ-004, label Unknown; DEC-005). What each may do is undecided (FEA-003, label Unknown; Q-001).
- Administrator or any other role: none is mentioned in any decision. Whether one is needed is open (FEA-010, label Unknown; Q-007).
- How employees sign in is not established by any supplied document.

## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage

Capture status is complete: one page ("Documents"), fixture mode, with screenshot, text, accessibility tree and HTML.

- Screen SCR-001 (Observed): "Documents", with an Upload button and a table (Name, Modified, unlabelled actions column).
- Components SCR-002 (Upload button, Observed) and SCR-003 (Documents table, Observed) with per-row Share and Delete buttons. Default state shows one row: "Q3 plan.docx", modified "2 days ago".
- Flows SCR-004, SCR-005 and SCR-006 (all Observed): the Upload, Share and Delete buttons have no captured target.
- Data entity SCR-007 (Observed): Document, with visible fields Name and Modified.
- Ambiguous behaviours: who can upload; accepted file types and sizes; upload failure; same-name uploads; who can share and delete; permission levels; delete confirmation, permanence and undo; effect on shares of deleting; the icon-only Delete button; meaning of Modified; sorting, filtering and pagination; empty list.
- Not observed: rename control, empty, loading, error and confirmation states, any dialog.

## 6. Requirements Traceability

| REQ-001 | Users should be able to manage their documents easily. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-001, FR-002, FR-014, FR-015, FR-016, FR-017, FR-018, AC-001, AC-002, AC-010 to AC-013; Q-002, Q-005, Q-006; DEC-001 |
| REQ-002 | The system must be fast. | addressed | Approved: DEC-003 | NFR-001, NFR-002; DEC-003 |
| REQ-003 | Documents should be secure. | addressed | Approved: DEC-004 | FR-003, FR-004, NFR-003, NFR-004, AC-003, AC-004; DEC-004 |
| REQ-004 | Sharing should work like in other tools. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-004, FR-005, FR-008, FR-009, FR-010, AC-004 to AC-008; Q-001, Q-003, Q-009; DEC-005 |
| REQ-005 | Pages load within two seconds for a library of up to 1,000 documents (created by DEC-003). | partially addressed | Unknown | NFR-002, AC-014; Q-008; DEC-003 |

## 7. Gaps Identified

| GAP-002 | What viewer and editor access each permit | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending, Q-001) | Over-exposure or deletion by non-owners cannot be ruled out until decided. |

| GAP-008 | Listing up to 1,000 documents: sort, filter, search and pagination | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | both | important | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
| GAP-009 | Empty, loading, success and error states unobserved | deferred (Deferred: DEC-007) | research | important | open (deferred) | Deferred at Checkpoint 2. |
