| GAP-015 | Meaning and format of "Modified" | approved (Approved: DEC-007) | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending, Q-010) | Owners may rely on Modified to notice editors' changes. |

## 8. Functional Requirements

Behaviours covered by deferred gaps (upload failure and duplicate names, the share dialog, list sorting and pagination, empty/loading/error states, revocation while a document is open, accessibility of per-row buttons, concurrent edits) are not specified here; see Deferred in section 3. Acceptance criteria marked (draft) rest on an item that is not Approved, Decided or Explicit. Acceptance criteria that state "placeholder" have no expected outcome yet and are not testable until the named question is answered.

### Document ownership and access

Purpose: signed-in employees manage their own documents, and only the owner and chosen colleagues can open them.

#### Confirmed requirements

- **FR-001** Upload, rename, delete and share are available to every signed-in employee on documents they own. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **FR-002** Upload, rename, delete and share are not offered on documents the employee does not own. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **FR-003** Only the owner and the named colleagues the owner has shared a document with, as viewer or editor, can open it; there are no public links. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-003] [Decision: DEC-004] [Decision: DEC-005]
- **FR-004** When the owner revokes a colleague's access, that colleague can no longer open the document. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-004] [Decision: DEC-005]

#### Undecided behaviour and assumptions

- **FR-005** Unknown: what an editor may do beyond the owner's actions (edit content only, or also rename, delete, re-share or change others' access) and whether a viewer may download or copy a document. If editors can re-share, documents can reach people the owner did not choose, which conflicts with DEC-004. Awaiting Q-001. FR-002 states that these actions are not offered on documents the employee does not own; how that applies to editors depends on the answer. [Inferred: FEA-003 · Unknown]
- **FR-006** Assumption: the access restriction in FR-003 applies to every way of opening a document, not only from the Documents list. How employees sign in is not established. [Assumption: ASM-F-001 · Assumption] [Customer: FEA-002]
- **FR-007** Unknown: what happens to an employee's documents and the shares on them when the employee leaves or the account is deactivated, and whether ownership can be transferred or documents recovered. Awaiting Q-007. [Inferred: FEA-010 · Unknown]

#### Acceptance criteria

- **AC-001** Given a signed-in employee who owns a document, When they use the Documents list, Then rename, delete and share can be started for that document and Upload is available (where the rename control appears is not yet decided). [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **AC-002** Given a signed-in employee who neither owns document D nor has been given access to it, When they use the Documents list or any route offering actions on D, Then rename, delete and share are not offered for D. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **AC-003** Given a signed-in employee who neither owns document D nor has been given access to it, When they try to open D, Then they cannot open it. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
- **AC-004** Given document D owned by O and shared with colleague C, When O revokes C's access and C then tries to open D, Then C cannot open D. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-005]
- **AC-005** (draft) Placeholder, not testable until Q-001 is answered: Given a colleague C with viewer or editor access to document D, When C attempts to rename, delete, re-share, change others' access or download D, Then the expected outcome is to be defined from the answer; no pass or fail condition is chosen here. [Inferred: FEA-003 · Unknown]

### Sharing

Purpose: owners give named colleagues access to a document and can take it away.

#### Customer answers on requirements that still carry an open issue

REQ-004 still carries the issue `unknown` (label Unknown) pending Q-001 and Q-003, so the line below records the customer's answer in DEC-005 and is not confirmed.

- **FR-008** Owners share a document with named colleagues as viewer or editor, like Google Drive, and can revoke access at any time. The Google Drive reference is the customer's wording; which Google Drive behaviours apply beyond viewer, editor and revocation is not specified. [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-005]

#### Undecided behaviour and assumptions

- **FR-009** Unknown: who counts as a named colleague (assumed to be other signed-in employees of the organisation only) and how the owner finds and picks them. Awaiting Q-003. [Inferred: FEA-015 · Unknown] [Assumption: ASM-G-001 · Assumption]
- **FR-010** Unknown: whether a colleague is told when a document is shared with them, when their role changes or when access is revoked, and through which channel. Awaiting Q-009. [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown]

#### Recommendations awaiting approval

- **FR-011** Consider a record of sharing, revocation and deletion that lets owners see who was given access, whose access was revoked and when a document was deleted. No requirement asks for it and the customer stated that no compliance rules apply. Awaiting Q-009. [Inferred: FEA-013 · Recommended (awaiting approval)]

#### Acceptance criteria

- **AC-006** (draft) Given document D owned by O, When O shares D with a named colleague C as viewer, Then C can open D. [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-005]
- **AC-007** Given an owner using any sharing option, When they look for a way to share by public link, Then none is provided. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-005]
- **AC-008** (draft) Placeholder, not testable until Q-003 is answered: Given an owner who names a person who is not a signed-in employee of the organisation (for example an external person), When they share, Then the expected accept or reject behaviour is to be defined from the answer; none is chosen here. [Inferred: FEA-015 · Unknown] [Assumption: ASM-G-001]

### Documents list

Purpose: the page where employees see and act on their documents.

#### Undecided behaviour and assumptions

- **FR-012** Unknown: where a colleague finds documents shared with them (in the Documents list, elsewhere, or nowhere) and which actions appear on a row the user does not own. Awaiting Q-004. [Inferred: FEA-004 · Unknown]
- **FR-013** Unknown: which changes update "Modified", whether it shows who made the change, and how older dates and time zones are shown. Awaiting Q-010. [Inferred: FEA-014 · Unknown]

- **AC-009** (draft) Placeholder, not testable until Q-004 is answered: Given colleague C who has been given access to document D, When C views the Documents list, Then where D appears and which actions are shown on it are to be defined from the answer. [Inferred: FEA-004 · Unknown]

Behaviour above 1,000 documents, the measurement method and the test conditions are not specified (Q-008). [Decision: REQ-005 · Unknown] [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Assumption: ASM-G-002]

Purpose: the document actions other than sharing, each limited to two clicks.

REQ-001 still carries the issue `unknown` (label Unknown), and what counts as a click is undecided (FEA-009, Q-005), so the line below records the customer's answer in DEC-001 and is not confirmed.

## 9. State Transitions and Edge Cases

### Document lifecycle

States: No document; Owned document, not shared; Shared document (an owned document with at least one colleague holding access).

| State | Event | Next state | Who can trigger | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| No document | Employee uploads a file | Owned document, not shared | Any signed-in employee | [Customer: REQ-001 · Unknown] |
| Owned document, not shared or Shared document | Owner renames | Same state, with the new name (rules Unknown) | Owner | [Customer: REQ-001 · Unknown] |
| Owned document, not shared | Owner shares with a named colleague as viewer or editor | Shared document | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
| Shared document | Owner revokes the last colleague's access | Owned document, not shared | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-005] |
| Owned document, not shared or Shared document | Owner deletes | Unknown (permanently removed, or recoverable; effect on colleagues' access Unknown) | Owner | [Inferred: FEA-006 · Unknown] |
| Owned document, not shared or Shared document | Owner's account is deactivated or the owner leaves | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-010 · Unknown] |
| Shared document | Editor attempts an action beyond opening and viewing | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-003 · Unknown] |

### Access grant lifecycle (one colleague on one document)

| State | Event | Next state | Who can trigger | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| No access | Owner shares as viewer | Viewer | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
| No access | Owner shares as editor | Editor | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
| Viewer or editor | Owner revokes access | No access | Owner | [Customer: REQ-004 · Unknown] |
| Viewer | Role change to editor | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown] |
| Editor | Role change to viewer | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown] |

Edge cases: destructive action (delete) and its recovery are Unknown (FR-016); invalid rename input is Unknown (FR-017); unauthorised opening is covered by AC-003 and AC-004. Empty, loading, error, upload failure, duplicate-name and concurrency behaviour have no decision and are listed under Deferred in section 3, and repeated upload submissions belong to deferred GAP-006. Duplicate shares and repeated share submissions are not covered by any input (see section 1).

## 10. Non-Functional Requirements

- **NFR-001** The system must be fast; DEC-003 defines this as the two-second page-load target in NFR-002. [Customer: REQ-002 · Approved: DEC-003] [Decision: DEC-003]
- **NFR-002** Pages load within two seconds for a library of up to 1,000 documents.
